description: In repos/goal-host-vessel/src/index.ts the registry oracle chooses which registry field to verify with a line that reads exactly: const field = /\bvessels?\b/.test(g) ? "totalVessels" and that line occurs exactly once in the file. The vessel test runs first and matches the word vessel ANYWHERE in the goal, including where it names the subject of an unrelated clause, so a goal asking how many SHAPES the registry advertises is graded against totalVessels and a correct answer is failed. Change the field selection so the counted entity is taken from the noun attached to the counting clause rather than from any occurrence of the word: prefer a match of how many / number of / total immediately followed by shapes when choosing totalShapes, and immediately followed by vessels when choosing totalVessels, and when neither counting clause is present return null so the oracle abstains. Abstaining costs one LLM judgement; grading the wrong field beta-penalises an arm that computed the right answer. Nonce oracle-field-4f2c.
